question: In what respects are the thirty-six deities equal to the principal goddess?
premises: There are thirty-six of these deities.
They are equal to the goddess.
Their equality extends to all forms, weapons, and other attributes.
inference: The thirty-six deities are equal to the goddess in all forms, weapons, and other attributes.
plain_english: Those thirty-six are equal to the goddess in all forms, weapons, and other attributes.
